CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified contents.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates) is listed separately from an explicit origin/status entry for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition linked to content presentation/emergence/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify represented contents and attributes (color sets) with coordinates.

D.rationale: The report separately attributes content (color/co-ordinates) and an origin/status object for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/representation metadata describe how contents are accessed/presented (copied_prior_record, inherited_current, feedback_through/command_estimate).
